title: Log levels
description:
Count log lines by level and choose what a log window shows.

```
INFO 120  WARN 7  ERROR 2
show: WARN and up -> 9 lines
newest error: "texture missing: grass.png" (line 118)
colours: INFO grey, WARN yellow, ERROR red
```
hints: `static_cast<int>(level)` turns the enum into an index for the counts and the comparison (lesson 5.02).
ImGui's `IM_COL32(r, g, b, a)` packs as `a << 24 | b << 16 | g << 8 | r`.
requirements: Lines are `(level, text)`; keep counts per level as lines arrive.
`visible(minimumLevel)` returns the indexes of lines at or above it.
A colour per level as an `ImU32`-style packed `0xAABBGGRR` value.
stretch: Collapse repeated identical lines into one with a count, like browser consoles do.
